name: Power HF Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Weifang, China, in 1920, Power HF Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of diesel engines designed for non-road applications. Their comprehensive product range encompasses diesel engines, gas engines, complete generator sets, and various precision-machined components. These solutions are vital for diverse sectors, including stationary and onshore power generation, heavy engineering, agricultural equipment, and marine industries.
